description: This Dart source file defines a 'PlayerScreen' widget for a Flutter application, implementing a custom video player stub with playback controls, scrubbing, orientation locking, and progress persistence.

classes.name: PlayerScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing a media player screen with playback controls and orientation management.

classes.name: _PlayerScreenState
classes.description: State class managing playback state, UI interactions, and integration with controllers.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, sets start position, starts ticker, and locks landscape orientation.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up timers and restores orientation when widget is disposed.

methods.name: _startTicker
methods.description: Starts a periodic timer to update playback position.

methods.name: _lockLandscape
methods.description: Locks the device orientation to landscape mode.

methods.name: _restoreOrientation
methods.description: Restores device orientation to allow all modes.

methods.name: _syncMiniPlayer
methods.description: Synchronizes current playback state with the mini-player controller.

methods.name: togglePlayPause
methods.description: Toggles between play and pause states.

methods.name: seekBy
methods.description: Adjusts playback position by a delta amount of seconds.

methods.name: persistProgress
methods.description: Persists current playback progress asynchronously and shows confirmation.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks playback as complete, resets position, and updates state.

methods.name: minimizeToMiniPlayer
methods.description: Minimizes the player into a mini-player view and navigates back.

methods.name: _format
methods.description: Formats seconds into a human-readable m s string.

methods.name: _previewColorForSecond
methods.description: Generates a color for thumbnail previews based on the second.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the player screen UI.
